'''P'chab''' was an [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] meat seasoning that could improve the flavor of [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. It could be purchased in [[Saludi's]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], where people smoked it, despite it not being a narcotic.<ref name="CD">{{LivingForce|Coruscani Dawn}}</ref>
